description: Retrieve the full body of a licensed article using a buyer API token (opedd_buyer_live_* canonical; opedd_buyer_test_* for sandbox). Requires OPEDD_BUYER_TOKEN env var (create one at opedd.com/licenses after purchasing). Works for licence orders (and for licences bought before Human republication, Full catalogue and client display retired): an AI answers subscription returns the full text of any article in the publisher's catalogue, old or new, counted against a daily reading limit (20 full articles per person and 200 per organisation by default; the same article again the same day is free; over the limit answers 429 DAILY_READING_LIMIT with the reset time, and questions are still answered). Your self-serve buyer API key, or the Opedd connector sign-in, reads articles under every order your account holds and every subscription your company holds for your work email — no separate order token is needed. AI answers pay-per-request (including the self-serve licence) does NOT retrieve articles: it answers 403 SEARCH_ONLY_LICENCE — ask a question with search_passages instead. Articles the publisher stopped licensing answer 403 ARTICLE_EXCLUDED. The publisher must have content delivery enabled and must have pushed content for the article. The response includes author, language, word_count, content_hash, image_urls, canonical_url and tags. On pre-2026-05-14 historical articles, optional fields (author/language/image_urls/canonical_url/tags) may be NULL. NULL means the data is unavailable for this article, not that it is empty.

article_id.description: The Opedd article UUID to retrieve content for

buyer_token.description: Buyer API token (opedd_buyer_live_* or opedd_buyer_test_*). Falls back to OPEDD_BUYER_TOKEN env var.

publisher_id.description: Optional: read only if the article belongs to this publisher (UUID). A publication's own connector sets it.

name: get_content
title: Read a licensed article
